title: State how missing values are handled
description: Any analysis that aggregates, filters or models data must say explicitly how missing values (NaN/None) are treated: dropped, imputed (and how), or kept as their own category.
author: team

title: Never modify the raw dataframe in place
description: The raw dataset loaded from disk must not be mutated. Derive new dataframes (e.g. df_clean) instead of reassigning or using inplace=True on the raw one.
author: team

title: Label every chart
description: Every plot must have a title, axis labels with units, and a legend when more than one series is shown.
author: team

title: Report effect sizes with significance tests
description: When running a statistical test, report the effect size and confidence interval alongside the p-value, and name the test used.
author: team
